title: Record a digest of each staged skill version and refuse a changed one at run time
goal: Only the text the owner staged and promoted reaches the planner
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) edits a promoted invented skill's stored SKILL.md and expects chooseActiveSkill to refuse it with a reason naming the change, and the planner prompt to carry no instructions

stageSkillPackage records a sha-256 of the stored package files in the registry; loadSkillVersion, or the run-time matcher, compares it; a version staged before the digest existed is refused at run time until it is staged again as a new version, and the guide says so

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one digest at staging, one comparison, tests. Not a measurement.

privacy: Neutral invented skills only; no owner data, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
